risks: Starting Aurora, one Cell ALB and one Fargate API task resumes ongoing charges; 50USD is a target, not a hard cap. No platform/prod restore or automatic TTL.
CFN is sole resource owner. New physical IDs/outputs/routing are unknown until true restore and cannot be taken from historical ARNs. New rights are not silently approved.
Normal CFN rollback can leave partial resources or roll old declarations back; external DB start, images, SQL, binding and Git activation are not atomic or automatically compensated.
Conditional image uploads and database CAS are separate services; uploaded public files may remain on row failure. Original files/rows remain, no delete/overwrite/down/automatic retry.
Database IAM credentials and owner config enter memory; raw templates/private metadata and SQL may be visible to providers/logs. No credential/body publication to GitHub.
Initial owner seed/independent inspection use temporary membership writes, not read-only transactions; creator ADMIN remains and unknown commit stops.
Runtime activation is a real later authorization, not implied by this preparation. It enables installed OIDC/workflow capabilities but does not itself prove both normal release runs.
exclusions: legacy direct-resource v1 or old write replay
